system.description:
PLANT SOUL UTILITY WARDING
Tradition verdant
Cast 10 minutes (material, somatic, verbal)
Area 30-foot radius centred upon a living tree, significant fungal growth or other established natural feature
Duration 1 hour

You awaken the accumulated spiritual memory of a place, creating a temporary sanctuary where the living and the remembered can coexist.
Within the grove:
Willing living creatures gain a +2-status bonus Will saving throws against Fear, possession and effects with the Soul trait.
Corpses do not naturally decay.
A willing disembodied spirit connected to the location, the creatures present or remains within the area may manifest sufficiently to be seen, heard and communicated with.
Hostile possession effects originating within the area suffer a -2-status penalty to their Counteract or Spellcraft checks, as appropriate.
This manifestation does not compel a spirit to appear, answer questions or remain within the grove. It does not summon a particular deceased creature from another plane.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the radius by 10 feet.
+4 PP: Increase the duration to 1 day.
+6 PP: Willing spirits manifested through the grove may remain visible and audible for the entire duration without requiring another magical effect.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. The +2 status to Will against Fear, possession and Soul effects is a scoped bonus on each willing creature in the grove; the rest is the GM's.
